evidence: Carries 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and modifies chainstate compaction in src/validation.cpp, src/txdb.cpp, and src/dbwrapper.cpp.
rationale: Prevents node crashes and shutdown hangs caused by background chainstate compaction exhausting disk space. Issue #36585 reported that automatic background compaction 'filled the disk; node then hung after shutdown (v32.0rc3)', making this an important reliability regression fix for node stability.
